entries.hypothesis: A fixed half-and-half logit blend of the model and the single-book market probability improves Main ROI versus Baseline B (no fitted weight, so it can be tested forward without re-tuning).
entries.rule: Production Main rule on p = softmax(0.5 log q + 0.5 log p_model) per market (handicap on the no-refund scale, double chance from the blended 1X2); q = power de-margining of the first complete book among bet365 (OddsPapi), Football-Data Bet365, Pinnacle, William Hill at the decision moment; candidates without a complete book keep the model probability.
entries.primary_metric: paired ROI difference vs Baseline B at the T universe (bootstrap by match)
secondary: the same at the closing universe
share of Main with a market probability
entries.decision: B (exploratory; chosen after seeing 2026/27, so only a forward result counts)

note: B candidates frozen for a forward check on matches played after frozen_at; production is not changed.
